description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableFeatureDefinitionIdentifier' which implements the 'DefinitionIdentifier' interface. It provides methods to create, parse, and access parts of a feature definition identifier within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class encapsulates the identifier's namespace, name, and version, ensuring immutability and proper equality semantics.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinitionIdentifier
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the 'DefinitionIdentifier' interface, representing a feature definition identifier with namespace, name, and version components.

methods.description: Returns the namespace of the identifier.
